errors.text_span: Оста Y е означена като "Приходи от електронна търговия (млрд. долара)"
errors.evidence: The Y-axis has no label. The text "Приходи от електронна търговия (млрд. долара)" is the label for the blue area data series, taken from the legend.
The chart shows a blue filled area (an area chart), not a blue line.

The chart shows a single data series for growth, represented by brown percentage labels along the top edge of the area. The legend marker is orange. The description incorrectly states there are multiple ("линии" - plural) red ("червени") lines.
The description fails to mention the main title of the chart, which is "ПРИХОДИ ОТ ДРОПШИПИНГ" (REVENUE FROM DROPSHIPPING).

The description omits most of the explicitly labeled data points. For revenue, it omits the values for 2018 (134), 2019 (156), 2020 (191), 2021 (211), and 2022 (245). For growth, it omits the values for 2017 (0%), 2019 (16%), 2020 (22%), 2021 (10%), and 2022 (16%).
